channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Arruda recorre ao TSE após TRE-DF barrar sua candidatura ao governo
item.description: José Roberto Arruda, PSD candidate for the Federal District government, appealed to the TSE after the TRE-DF rejected his candidacy registration. The decision by the electoral court will be reviewed by the higher electoral authority in the coming days.

item.title: Lula questiona Alcolumbre por adiar votação do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula questioned the Senate's decision not to bring to the floor the proposal ending the 6×1 scale, previously approved in committee. In an interview with Rádio Progresso, he expressed discomfort with the postponement of the vote under Davi Alcolumbre's leadership.

item.title: Quaest: para 57%, ausência de candidato em debates não afeta decisão do voto
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that 57% of voters do not consider a candidate’s absence in debates as a decisive factor in their vote. However, 37% say that not participating in debates reduces their likelihood of voting for the candidate. Lula leads with 37% of voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 29%.

item.title: Ministério Público Eleitoral abre apuração sobre eventual abuso de poder de Renan Santos
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry has opened a preliminary investigation into Renan Santos over suspected abuse of power and illegal fundraising, linked to delays in registering social media accounts used in his campaign. The delay sparked criticism and a temporary suspension of digital campaigning, lifted days later. The candidate's defense requests the investigation be expanded to all candidates.

item.title: Como a esquerda tem reagido ao cerco contra Moraes no escândalo do Master
item.description: The Brazilian left takes a cautious stance regarding the accusations against Minister Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master scandal, avoiding outright defenses and emphasizing impartial investigations and the presumption of innocence. Some leaders, such as Edinho Silva and Zeca Dirceu, stress the need to investigate all involved parties, maintaining a balanced position between institutional respect and demands for transparency.

item.title: Lula diz esperar que PEC do fim da escala 6×1 avance após o primeiro turno das eleições
item.description: President Lula stated he expects the approval of the PEC ending the 6×1 electoral scale after the first round of elections, criticizing the slow progress in the Senate. Lula highlighted that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promised the vote will take place in the plenary, but expressed dissatisfaction with the measure not advancing this week.

item.title: Como estava a disputa entre Lula e Bolsonaro nas pesquisas a um mês da eleição de 2022
item.description: The Datafolha poll released on September 1, 2022, showed Lula with 45% of voting intentions against Jair Bolsonaro's 32% in the first round, with a 13 percentage point lead. In the second round, Lula led with 53% against Bolsonaro's 38%. In 2026, the dynamics have changed significantly, with Lula (38%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (33%) in a more balanced race.

item.title: Viana quer fim do recesso do Senado diante da crise no STF
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) calls for an end to the electoral recess in the Senate to address the STF crisis. He proposes that lawmakers return to Brasília next Tuesday to discuss the institutional situation and pressure the government.

item.title: USA Rare Earth conclui compra da Serra Verde, em Goiás
item.description: USA Rare Earth has completed the acquisition of 100% of Brazilian rare earth miner Serra Verde for $2.8 billion, advancing its strategy to diversify the global rare earth supply chain beyond China. The deal integrates the sole Brazilian producer of essential magnetic elements into the company's portfolio, with plans to scale annual rare earth oxide output from 4,000 to 6,400 tons by 2026. This move aims to meet growing demand for critical materials in sectors such as renewable energy, AI, and national defense.

item.title: Lula avalia indicar Ricardo Couto ao STF
item.description: President Lula is considering appointing Rio de Janeiro's interim governor Ricardo Couto to the STF, aiming to overcome the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias. This move would help avoid scandal-related associations and ease parliamentary tensions, as Lula emphasizes impartial investigations.

item.title: Crusoé: Censura em campanha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli suspended the electoral advertising of Renan Santos's (Mission) campaign, ordering its suspension through any channels. The decision directly impacts the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Associação pede que STF derrube decreto mineiro que restringe publicidade de bets
item.description: The National Association of Games and Lotteries (ANJL) filed a lawsuit at the Supreme Federal Court against a Minas Gerais decree banning betting advertisements in public spaces and state events, claiming federal overreach and violation of the principle of legality. The case (ADI 8014) is handled by Minister Flávio Dino and seeks the annulment of Decree 49.279/2026.

item.title: Quando votar é uma escolha: o direito de comparecer ou não às urnas
item.description: The text explores how optional voting, granted to 16- and 17-year-olds, illiterate individuals, and those over 70, turns electoral participation into a personal choice. Through the stories of José da Silva, 72, and Martina Matteo Ferreira, 16, it shows how some choose to continue voting out of conviction, while others participate for the first time with critical awareness. The scenario reflects a transformation in the Brazilian electorate, with an increase in optional voters in the coming decades.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que ‘sem dúvidas’ apoiaria Tarcísio ao Planalto em 2030
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he would support Tarcísio de Freitas for the presidency in 2030, calling him a key figure on the center-right. The comment followed a joint event in São Carlos, strengthening electoral alliances. Flávio has advocated ending reelection, signaling openness for new candidates.

item.title: Zema critica fim da taxação das blusinhas sem contrapartidas para empresas nacionais: 'isonomia é fundamental'
item.description: Romeu Zema criticized the end of taxation on international purchases up to US$ 50, calling the measure an 'absurdity' for favoring foreign companies over Brazilian ones. At a meeting with retail business leaders, he emphasized fair competition and warned about the rising number of judicial recoveries and bankruptcies in Brazil. The approved MP includes an assessment mechanism for the economic impacts of the exemption.

item.title: Lula vai usar mote 'A Força que Une o Brasil' para desfile de 7 de setembro
item.description: The federal government announced that the 7th of September parade in Brasília will use 'A Força que Une o Brasil' as its central motto. The phrase will be displayed on the Esplanada dos Ministérios, which is being prepared for the event. The date holds symbolic significance for the country and the Lula administration (PT).

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência arrecadam R$ 88,8 mi a 1 mês da eleição
item.description: Presidential candidates raised R$ 88.8 million one month before the 2026 election, accounting for 7.69% of the spending cap. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with R$ 43.7 million, followed by Lula (PT) with R$ 35.3 million and Caiado (PSD) with R$ 2.9 million.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita as obras das galerias do Cinturão das Águas do Ceará
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visits the Cinturão das Águas do Ceará gallery construction site in Crato, accompanied by ministers and local officials. The event is scheduled for 3:20 PM at the Santuário Nossa Senhora do Rosário de Fátima parking area.

item.title: 30 anos da urna eletrônica, símbolo das eleições brasileiras
item.description: In 2026, the electronic voting machine turns 30 in Brazilian elections, marking a transformation in voting and tallying. Its trajectory, begun in 1996, reflects debates on security, transparency, and accessibility.

item.title: Quaest mostra ‘goleada’ de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 4, 2026 shows President Lula (PT) leading by a wide margin over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) among Ceará voters, with a margin of error of three percentage points. The poll, filed with the Electoral Court, indicates Lula would receive between 51% and 54% of voting intentions, while Flávio would reach 16%, depending on the scenario analyzed.

item.title: Moisés Selerges: ‘É possível acabar com a escala 6×1 em todos os setores’
item.description: Moisés Selerges, former president of the Metalworkers Union and federal candidate backed by Lula, advocates expanding the 6×1 shift reduction to a 40-hour week across all sectors, citing productivity and technology gains. He proposes forming a 'workers' bench' in Congress to push these reforms and address labor precarity in digital platforms.

item.title: A aposta do PT na neutralidade ‘pró-Lula’ do Centrão no Rio
item.description: The PT bets on the neutrality of centrist leaders in Rio to contain support for Flávio Bolsonaro, with a strategy of alliances aimed at electing Eduardo Paes and isolating the PL candidate. A survey shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio in the first round, with 34% and 36% of voting intentions, respectively.

item.title: Em evento no Planalto, Gonet exalta “comunhão” dos Três Poderes
item.description: Paulo Gonet, Brazil's Attorney General, praised the 'harmony of the Three Powers' at a Planalto event, emphasizing collaboration to strengthen justice institutions. The event coincided with a public dispute between ministers Alexandre Moraes and André Mendonça over investigations involving Banco Master.

item.title: As primeiras pesquisas presidenciais após o escândalo envolvendo Moraes e Vorcaro
item.description: Following the scandal involving Supreme Court justices and banker Daniel Vorcaro, polling firms are preparing to release new surveys for the 2026 presidential race. The forecasts are expected to reveal whether the case affects voter intentions for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, who currently lead the polls.

item.title: Não posso parar de ser presidente porque sou candidato, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated he cannot stop being president because he is a candidate, emphasizing that he does not confuse governmental activity with electoral campaign. He attended a bill signing creating special funds for the judiciary and public prosecutors, and joked about the lack of coffee, suggesting someone may have interpreted serving food as potential vote buying.

item.title: Quaest: no Ceará, Lula tem 54%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 16%; e Cury, 10%
item.description: A new Quaest poll in Ceará shows Lula leading with 54% of first-round voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (16%) and Augusto Cury (10%). The survey also shows a technical tie between Lula and Bolsonaro in a hypothetical second round. Lula's government holds a 60% approval rating in the state.

item.title: Veículos de comunicação da Câmara e do Senado farão cobertura integrada das eleições
item.description: The communication outlets of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate will provide integrated coverage of the October 4th elections, featuring live broadcasts, interviews and political analyses. The coverage includes the count for 513 federal deputies and 54 senators, with real-time data and updates on party benches, renewal rates and profiles of elected officials. The news agencies of both houses offer specialized content on social media and dedicated websites.

item.title: Procurado por Gilmar, chefe da PF diz concordar com veto a delegados no STF
item.description: Supreme Court minister Gilmar Mendes and Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues discussed banning PF delegates from serving as seconded personnel in Supreme Court offices. Gilmar supports the veto and received full backing from Andrei, who also emphasized cooperation between the PF and Congress. The debate unfolds amid tensions between Supreme Court justices such as André Mendonça and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Kassio lacra sistemas das eleições e diz que Justiça não escolhe vencedores
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, sealed the electronic systems to be used in the 2026 elections, ensuring the integrity and security of electoral processes. Kassio emphasized that the Electoral Justice does not interfere in popular choice and reaffirmed the commitment to democracy and the sovereignty of the Brazilian people. The procedure formalizes the official versions of electoral programs and security mechanisms, including encryption and audits.

item.title: Relatório ‘sem valor probatório’ da PF foi solicitado por Moraes após embate com Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes requested intelligence reports from the Federal Police mentioning names of fellow justices, following a tense meeting with André Mendonça, the rapporteur of the Fake News inquiry. The decision arises amid allegations that Moraes was being investigated unlawfully. Moraes also cited alleged evidence of crimes involving the fabrication of evidence against his colleagues.

item.title: UE insiste que embargo à carne brasileira é ‘proporcional’ após Lula ameaçar ‘reciprocidade’
item.description: The European Union imposed an embargo on Brazilian meat after Brazil was removed from a list of countries compliant with antimicrobial regulations, prompting Lula's government to threaten 'reciprocity' measures. The EU claims the action is proportional and gave Brazil sufficient time to adapt, while Brazil rejects the move and emphasizes its compliance efforts.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE conclui assinatura digital e lacra sistemas das urnas eletrônicas
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) finalized the digital signature and sealing of the electronic voting systems for the 2026 elections, scheduled for October 4 and 25. The procedure, conducted in the court's vault, ensures the authenticity and integrity of the software, preventing any modifications after signing. Authorities including TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, representatives from the Federal Police, the OAB, the Public Ministry, and the court itself were present.

item.title: “Mendonça tem que dar voz de prisão a Moraes em plenário”, diz Nikolas
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) stated that Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça should order the arrest of fellow Minister Alexandre de Moraes during a full court session. His remarks came after Moraes requested Mendonça's investigation for alleged abuse of power, linked to the declassification of messages from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. Nikolas was also mentioned in documents tied to Vorcaro, denying he received money or met with him.

item.title: Fachin retira de inquérito das fake news pedido de Moraes para abertura de processo contra Mendonça
item.description: The president of the Supreme Federal Court, Minister Edson Fachin, removed from the fake news investigation the request by Minister Alexandre de Moraes to open a case against Minister André Mendonça. Fachin ordered the Attorney General's Office and Mendonça to express their views within five days, transferring the cases to the Court's Presidency.

item.title: Paula Lavigne faz pedido a Lula sobre bets: "Acabe com esse horror"
item.description: Paula Lavigne asked President Lula to end betting platforms in Brazil, calling the phenomenon 'horror'. During an event, she highlighted the negative impact of bets on culture and audiences, criticizing market saturation and complaining that small artists are pressured to accept sponsorships from these platforms.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula sanciona atos sobre fundos do sistema de Justiça
item.description: President Lula signs normative acts regarding justice system funds in a ceremony at the Planalto Palace. The event takes place on Friday morning, with live broadcast scheduled for 10 AM. It is an initiative focused on judicial structure reform.

item.title: Voto no exterior cresce 31%; saiba como votar e justificar a ausência
item.description: Overseas voting increased by 31.82% in the 2026 elections, with 918,876 voters registered across 134 countries. Voting is mandatory for literate Brazilians aged 18 to 70 and optional for 16-17 year-olds, illiterate voters, and those over 70. The vote is limited to president and vice-president, with registration closed on May 6th and absence justification due by December 3rd.

item.title: Áudio: Aprovada exceção a regras fiscais para benefícios tributários e despesas de 2026
item.description: The Senate approved a constitutional amendment bill that waives fiscal responsibility law limits for 2026 tax benefits and expenditures. The measure also modifies the compliance rule to ensure voluntary transfers to municipalities with fewer than 65,000 residents. The bill moves to presidential approval.

item.title: Moraes usa documento da PF apócrifo e sem valor probatório contra André Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes used an internal Federal Police document deemed to lack evidential value to request the investigation of his fellow justice André Mendonça for alleged abuse of authority and administrative misconduct. The move sparked controversy due to the use of material not officially recognized as valid evidence.

item.title: Flávio diz ser alvo de articulação de Moraes, Dino e Alcolumbre
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Minister Moraes, Flávio Dino, and Davi Alcolumbre of political coordination against him without providing concrete evidence. He also called for protests and criticized Lula, while Alcolumbre defended Moraes in the Senate.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE registra a versão dos programas que será instalada nas urnas
item.description: The TSE performs at 8:30 am this Friday (September 4, 2026) the digital signature of the software that will be used in electronic voting machines in the elections. After the ceremony, the physical media containing the programs will be sealed and stored in a safe, where it will remain until it is copied and installed on the devices that will be used in the election.

item.title: 'Não tem ninguém certo nessa história': analistas apontam crise sem precedentes e enraizada no STF
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) is experiencing an unprecedented institutional crisis after Minister Alexandre de Moraes requested an investigation into his colleague André Mendonça, accusing him of misconduct and political favoritism. The escalating conflict, involving Federal Police reports, was reciprocated with Mendonça accusing Moraes, reinforcing the perception that the Court is imploding without a clear resolution.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta sexta-feira (4)
item.description: On Friday (4), presidential candidates follow a busy agenda with rallies, walks, interviews and institutional events. Candidates like Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema and Caiado visit innovation hubs, meet business leaders and participate in Q&A sessions. Some, such as Samara Martins and Wilson Grassi, do not reveal public agendas.

item.title: Mercados aguardam payroll decisivo para os juros nos Estados Unidos
item.description: Markets await the August US payroll report to guide the next Federal Reserve decision, expecting 56k jobs created with unemployment steady at 4.1%. In Brazil, Ibovespa ends flat after 11 gains, while EWZ futures rise, driven by election betting favoring Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula vai ao Ceará enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro faz comício com Tarcísio em São Carlos
item.description: President Lula visits water infrastructure projects in Ceará, while Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio hold a rally in São Carlos. Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema maintain an agenda of interviews and debates in São Paulo.

item.title: Entenda a reviravolta que levou ao fim da "taxa das blusinhas"
item.description: The Brazilian Congress approved a provisional measure maintaining the end of the 'blusinhas tax,' keeping exempt the 20% fee on international purchases up to 50 dollars. The decision, heading to Lula's sanction, benefits platforms like Shein and Shopee but opposes protectionist trends in the US and EU.

item.title: 'Crise no STF se agrava': o que diz imprensa internacional sobre disputa entre Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: The crisis at Brazil's Supreme Court intensified after corruption allegations between justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça involving INSS and Banco Master cases. International media highlighted the political polarization and implications for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula sanciona programa para desenvolver indústria de fertilizantes
item.description: President Lula signed PL 699/2023, creating Profert to develop the fertilizer industry, but partially vetoed the bill to avoid restricting fertilizers to domestically produced goods. The sanction was published in the DOU and enacted as Law 15.495.

item.title: Governo Lula: leia a agenda de ministros do governo nesta 6ª feira
item.description: On Friday, September 4, 2026, ministers in President Lula's government are traveling to Ceará, Bahia, São Paulo, and Minas Gerais for infrastructure projects, creative economy discussions, port-related events, and highway inaugurations. Lula leads a delegation in Ceará while other ministers engage in cultural, economic, and transportation initiatives.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 6ª feira
item.description: Electoral polls registered with the TSE will be released for publication starting Friday (September 4, 2026), covering local races in the Federal District and 16 states. The Poder360 Research Aggregator offers subscribers comprehensive tracking of surveys since 2000, with 2026 data available during the election period.
